response.sql: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS b FROM site_avg), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS sa FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT a.zoneregistry, a.avg_faces, bl.b, st.sa FROM site_avg a JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = a.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline bl WHERE a.avg_faces > st.sa AND bl.b IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_kept_faces, AVG(avg_faces - b) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(avg_faces - sa) AS avg_excess_over_status FROM kept
